notice_texts: LATEST NEWS Raipur Homeopathy Medical College, Ramkund, Raipur & Raigarh College of Naturopathy, Kotrapali, Raigarh have received permission and affiliation for admissions in the academic session 2026-27. Therefore, both of these colleges will be included in the second round of counseling New BAMS-BHMS & BNYS 2026 round-1 allotment list has been published.
